mods.name: files-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

mods.name: timeline-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of this session's turns, newest first: start time, length, tool calls and cost of each, with a total. Open it with /timeline.

mods.name: context-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of how full the context window is: the percent as a bar, the tokens used, and a short tip past 75 percent. Open it with /context-pane.

mods.name: process-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the processes the session's Bash calls started that still run, with pid, age and command. Read-only: one ps every 5 seconds. Open it with /procs.
